changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'dbo' AND TABLE_NAME = 'MapSequenceContext') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[MapSequenceContext]( [MapSequenceID] [int] NOT NULL, [Object] [varchar](50) NOT NULL, [ObjectID] [int] NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MapSequenceContext] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [MapSequenceID] ASC, [Object] ASC, [ObjectID] ASC ) )
END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MapSequenceContext_MapSequence') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapSequenceContext] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MapSequenceContext_MapSequence] FOREIGN KEY([MapSequenceID]) REFERENCES [dbo].[MapSequence] ([ID]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [dbo].[MapSequenceContext] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MapSequenceContext_MapSequence] END
